## Checklist

- [ ] A regression test for every bug fix; new behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `docs/guide.md` (and the READMEs where it matters)
- [ ] A line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No new dependency, or it is listed in `ATTRIBUTION.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` is regenerated
